title: The Wounded Traveler
summary: Sintel, cloaked and carrying a glowing staff, travels alone through a vast misty snowscape. She is weary and injured.
events: Sintel walks alone through the snow
clues: Sintel is on a long solitary journey

title: Collapse in the Blizzard
summary: A blizzard hits. Sintel's bandaged, bleeding hand is shown in close-up. She struggles against the wind and finally collapses in the snow.
events: Sintel collapses exhausted in the snow
clues: Her hand injury is serious and untreated

title: Rescue
summary: Sintel stumbles through a snowy street and is found by an old shaman, who opens his door and takes her in.
events: Sintel is found by the shaman

title: A Baby Dragon
summary: Inside the hut, as the shaman examines Sintel's hand, a small red-scaled baby dragon nudges her from under the fireplace. Sintel wakes and gently pets it.
clues: Scales lives in the shaman's hut

title: Taught to Kill
summary: The shaman makes a throat-slashing gesture and demonstrates how to kill with a knife. Scales watches anxiously. Sintel's expression hardens with unease.
events: The shaman teaches Sintel to kill
clues: Sintel is being trained for something dark
questionsRaised: What does he want her to kill?

title: Trust
summary: Scales rests its head on Sintel's shoulder by the fire, then curiously mouths her bandaged hand. Sintel looks around the hut and notices dragon artifacts: crystals, a large dragon scale, a dragon figurine. She begins to understand the shaman's trade.
events: Sintel notices the shaman's dragon trophies
questionsRaised: Will she go through with it?

title: Play and the Forge
summary: Sintel and Scales play-wrestle joyfully. Later the shaman tends a fire with intense focus, working on something unseen.
events: The shaman works at the forge
clues: The shaman is forging a weapon

title: The Sword and the Map
summary: The shaman forges and quenches a blade, then presents it to Sintel. He shows her a map and points to a destination. Sintel grips the sword with resolve.
events: The shaman gives Sintel a sword
The shaman shows Sintel a map
clues: Sintel is being sent to kill a dragon
The map leads to the dragon's lair

title: Departure
summary: Sintel sits with Scales on her lap, torn. She looks at the map one last time, steels herself, and walks away from the hut into the cold, glancing back.
events: Sintel leaves the hut with the map
clues: Sintel is conflicted about her mission

title: The Journey to the Lair
summary: Sintel treks alone through harsh mountains — climbing, checking the map, camping at night — then finds a vast cave and climbs down inside.

title: Inside the Cave
summary: Sintel descends through a vast cavern with a waterfall and misty peaks. At a dark opening she sees a torch and a hooded figure, then a projection of a baby-dragon shape on the wall.
events: A vision of a baby dragon appears
clues: A baby-dragon image appears in the dragon's lair
questionsRaised: Why is there a baby-dragon image here?

title: The Dragon and the Story
summary: A great dark dragon appears in shadow. A Persian-style illustrated sequence tells the dragon's story — a ship, a knight fighting a dragon — then the real dragon reveals itself in the cave: larger, older, with big eyes and horns.
events: The dragon's story is shown in a vision
clues: The dragon in the cave has its own history

title: The Fight and the Recognition
summary: Sintel fights the dragon, striking its hide with her glowing blade. The dragon catches her blade in its jaws, then stops — it looks at her with recognition and whimpers. Sintel's face fills with dawning horror as she realizes the truth.
events: Sintel realizes the dragon is Scales
clues: The final dragon is Scales grown up
questionsResolved: Why is there a baby-dragon image here?

title: What She Has Done
summary: Sintel cradles the dying dragon's head in her arms as it lies still. She sobs over it, heartbroken, as the frame fades. End credits follow.
